Are you looking for a logistics job with more responsibility than just picking orders?
 As a Logistics Quality Controller, you check incoming fruit and vegetables before they are sent to supermarkets across the Netherlands. You inspect products for quality, freshness and shelf life. If something is not right, you report it immediately and make sure extra checks are carried out when needed.
 You also help with stock counts and other logistics tasks in the warehouse. You will work for a large, modern fruit and vegetable company with plenty of opportunities to grow.
 

Wat wij zoeken- You have some experience in logistics and work accurately
- You speak Dutch or English and are available full-time
- You take responsibility and keep a good overview

Wat jij gaat doen- Check incoming fruit and vegetables for quality and freshness
- Help with stock counts and other logistics tasks in the warehouse
- Report damaged or poor-quality products to the right department

Ons teamYou will work in a large, modern warehouse where fresh fruit and vegetables are handled every day. The team is international, practical and works closely together to make sure only good-quality products reach the customer.
Wat wij bieden- €3,000 – €3,300 per month, plus shift allowances
- Full-time job with plenty of opportunities to grow
- Free gym facilities and extra employee benefits

Imagine walking into a massive festival, a high-end wedding, or a VIP corporate event. The music is pumping, the vibe is perfect, and everything looks flawless. That is your work. Behind every unforgettable event is a powerhouse warehouse crew, and we want you to lead the charge. We are looking for a motivated Warehouse Specialist to join our fast-growing event rental team in Mijdrecht. If you love staying active, hate boring office desks, and want to work with a crew that feels like family, this is your ultimate next step.

Why this job beats your average warehouse gig:
 - Start early at 07:00 AM, finish by 17:30 PM. No late-night shifts disrupting your social life.
 - One hour you're prepping high-end designer gear for a VIP lounge, the next you're handling festival gear.
 - You control the flow. You pack the trucks, check the returns, and make sure the show can go on.
 - Skip the gym membership. This job keeps you active, energized, and moving.

What’s in it for you? (The Good Stuff)
We believe in rewarding hard work. That’s why we offer a killer benefits package:
 - A gross hourly wage between €14.80 and €16.50, depending on your experience.
 - Need quick cash? Choose weekly payouts. Prefer a big monthly chunk? Choose monthly or 4-weekly. You call the shots.
 - Throwing a party, BBQ, or birthday soon? You can borrow all our luxury event materials completely for FREE!
 - Travel allowance, 8.33% holiday pay, at least 25 vacation days, and instant pension buildup via Staffice from day one.
 - An informal, high-energy team where we work hard, laugh louder, and celebrate successes together.

Who are we looking for?
You don't need a decades-long resume; we hire for attitude and energy. You are a great fit if:
 - You are physically fit and love a hands-on, active job.
 - You speak either English or Dutch.
 - You see what needs to be done and jump right in—no micro-management here.
 - You live in or near Mijdrecht (with your own transport) and are available

As an all-round warehouse worker at our location in Hoofddorp, you take care of all common logistics activities in the warehouse. You start the day by checking pick lists and operating the reach truck to move pallets to height. During the workday, you process incoming goods, pack outgoing orders, and assist with loading trucks. Through your efforts, the flow of goods remains constantly in motion and the warehouse stays organized.

Responsibilities
 - Order picking using a reach truck and hand scanner
 - Safely transporting and storing goods in the warehouse
 - Loading and unloading trucks using appropriate equipment
 - Performing incoming and outgoing checks on goods
 - Packing, relabeling, and preparing orders for shipment
 - Maintaining administrative data in the WMS system
 - Cleaning and keeping the workplace and aisles tidy
 - Collaborating with colleagues to achieve daily targets
 - Complying with applicable safety and quality regulations

We are looking for
 - Good command of the English language, both spoken and written
 - Demonstrable experience working on a reach truck
 - Valid reach truck certificate is a strong plus
 - Ability to work accurately, independently, and in a structured manner
 - Flexible and proactive work attitude
 - Available for full-time employment

What we offer
 - Gross hourly wage between € 15.70 and € 17.00 per hour
 - 8% holiday allowance
 - 29 holiday days on an annual basis
 - Travel allowance according to regulations
 - Flexible payout and weekly salary payment
 - Intensive and personal guidance from Staffice
 - Working via Staffice at a genuinely involved client
 - A pleasant working atmosphere is guaranteed.

Why Staffice?
 - Fair, transparent, and people-oriented approach
 - Dedicated contact person who is always there for you
 - Fast handling of questions and administration
 - Opportunities to take training courses or obtain certificates

This vacancy in Hoofddorp is also interesting if you live in Nieuw-Vennep

Are you highly organized, commercially minded, and energized by coordinating projects from start to finish? Do you enjoy working with multiple stakeholders and ensuring that products, timelines, and customer expectations all come together successfully?

We are looking for a German-speaking Commercial Project Coordinator to oversee the successful execution of customer projects within an international retail environment. In this role, you will serve as the bridge between sales, sourcing, operations, and external partners to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to agreed specifications.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong interest in both project management and sales who enjoys working in a fast-paced, international setting.

- Coordinate and manage customer projects from initial brief through final delivery.
- Translate customer requirements and commercial agreements into clear internal action plans.
- Monitor project timelines, milestones, and deliverables across multiple departments.
- Act as a central point of coordination between internal teams and external partners.
- Identify potential bottlenecks, delays, or risks and proactively drive solutions.
- Ensure accurate execution of product specifications, packaging requirements, pricing information, and logistical details.
- Prepare and maintain project documentation, customer files, and reporting.
- Support customer implementation activities and follow up on ongoing projects.
- Collaborate closely with Sales, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Quality, and Product Development teams. Close collaboration is largely with the Head of Sales and Account Managers Germany.
- Maintain a clear overview of multiple simultaneous projects and communicate project status to stakeholders.

Requirements- Fluent German (C1+), combined with strong English communication skills.
- Experience within a retail, FMCG, consumer goods, sourcing, and/or private-label environment is a MUST.

jobs.occupation: Logistics Employee Reach Truck at DHL Bemmel (121134003)
jobs.description:
Will you be driving a reach truck at DHL in Bemmel soon?

Would you like to start in logistics and develop yourself into a reach truck driver? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for logistics employees who want to work with a reach truck.

No certificate yet? No problem: DHL will train you internally to become a reach truck driver – fully on the job and at our expense.

What will you do?

- Operating a reach truck to store and retrieve goods, including at height
- Moving pallets and goods throughout the warehouse
- Picking and scanning orders
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Ensuring a clean, safe, and organized workplace

You will work at a location that is continuously developing, where new clients are regularly being onboarded. This means you will constantly learn new processes.

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are eager to learn and want to develop into a reach truck driver
- You work accurately and with a focus on safety
- You are available for 32 to 40 hours per week in day shifts, Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00
- You speak Dutch or English

A reach truck certificate is a plus, but not required, we value motivation and commitment more, and we will provide your internal training at DHL.

Are you looking for the perfect part-time job? Then you've come to the right place! Manpower is looking for postal sorters for PostNL in Zwolle at Anthony Fokkerstraat 2, 8013 NS. What we ask of you is that you can come with your own transport, in connection with accessibility. There is no guarantee of hours in this role. You work based on the work that PostNL has to offer. It is important that you are available for at least 15 hours per week! An average shift lasts 3 to 5 hours. Because it depends on how much work there is at PostNL, the number of hours you can work can vary per week.

Employment agency Manpower is looking for postal sorters for the night shift at PostNL in Zwolle.

As a postal sorter, you are responsible for the mechanical sorting of national mail. This is a physical job, because you work standing up and regularly lift heavy boxes of mail. It is also important that you can work accurately, because the mail must be delivered to the correct address!

This is what you get

    -  €14.99 per hour
    
- Travel allowance in accordance with PostNL regulations
    
- Temporary employment contract via Manpower
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Access to more than 200 courses via the Manpower Academy
    
- Irregularity allowance of 20% for working between 20:00 and 22:00, and 40% for working between 22:00 and 6:00

    - Good command of Dutch and/or English, in connection with the safety instructions and because of the communication
    
- Own transport, for the morning, evening and night shift
    
- Able to provide a VOG

You can start as a postal employee as soon as possible. So don't wait any longer and apply today! Manpower will then contact you within two working days.

jobs.description:
Sea Freight Container Loader and Stowage Specialist
As a loader and stowage specialist for sea containers, you ensure that goods are prepared safely and efficiently for overseas transport. You start your workday at 08:30 by checking the loading lists and the cargo ready for shipment. Throughout the day, you accurately distribute the cargo within the containers, using a forklift and stowage materials to prevent shifting. Around 17:00, you close the last container of the day and ensure the loading administration is up to date. In this position, you work through Staffice at our client's location.

Responsibilities
 - Loading and unloading sea containers according to specific instructions.
 - Stowing and securing various types of goods.
 - Operating the forklift to move heavy pallets.
 - Checking outgoing goods for damage and correct quantities.
 - Completing relevant loading documents and checklists.
 - Keeping the work location and loading docks clean.
 - Applying the correct weight distribution within the containers.

We are looking for
 - Proven experience in loading and stowing sea containers.
 - Possession of a valid forklift certificate.
 - Proficiency in Dutch or English.
 - Physically fit and able to work accurately under time pressure.
 - Resident in the immediate vicinity of the work location.

We offer
 - Salary between 17.50 and 20.00 per hour.
 - Weekly payment of your salary.
 - Travel allowance.
 - Holiday pay and vacation days.
 - Personal guidance from Staffice.
 - Working hours from 08:30 to 17:00.
 - a pleasant working atmosphere is guaranteed.

As a Warehouse Coordinator, you are responsible for managing the daily receiving, storage, and distribution activities in the warehouse.
